positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Engineer Tier 2 January 2017-Present
Software Engineer Tier 1 March 2016-January 2017 
 
Currently working windows version of 3M's "Coding and Reimbursement System" which is used by tens of thousands of hospitals and payers worldwide. In this role I develop medical coding and compliance software using a variety of technologies and tools. Our core application is written in C/C++ with many supporting tools developed in C#. We are in the process of converting much of our application to HTML/JavaScript (using an embedded IE browser) so that the code base can be shared between the windows and web versions.

•	Coder Finder application has a capability to run either a window form or  web-form build using Asp.net/C#, HTML/CSS, JavaScript. 
•	Web-form is design with RestApi and MVC
•	Moving Legacy coding from JavaScript to AngugarJS
•	SDLC with code integration, testing and deployment ,Designing multi-tiered web based applications using .NET technologies ASP.NET,C#, Web Services, Windows services, MVC
•	Experience of working with databases like Oracle 10g,11g, SQL Server 2008
•	Code finder used Entity framework to pull all data for SQL/SQL Server.  
Technology : C/C++ , Javascript/HTML, C#, .Net, Win API, Git, CSS, AngularJS

positions.title: DevOps Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Provide health status of all clusters
Continue some of the pending fileserver tool improvements (C#,asp.net, SQL, web, proprietary tech). There is a suite of tools we use to manage customer ftps and you will work on making them more efficient, look better, and more intuitive. New features for customers such as fixing dispositioning reports (proprietary technology, SQL, possibly some tabular modeling), or security enhancements (C#,asp.net, SQL, web, possibly SAML)
Building a dash of live customer metrics. 

•	Build external health check status website
•	Able to make Web API call
•	Able to get token and sessionID with Web API
•	Integrating all the systems and support for functionality to install in real time productions
•	Developing XML schema files for storing applicants image data and portfolio and validating them
•	Experienced in using .Net technologies such as C#, ASP.Net, ADO.Net, .Net Remoting, Reflection, Web Services, Http Handlers and modules, XML/XSL/XSLT, and VB.Net.
•	Able to check with multiple clusters
Technologies: C#,.Net,MVC,Web API,AngularJS,Resful
